headline: Heads of Security reports learned attention gates that improve prompt-injection robustness in two open-weight models
summary: The preprint introduces Heads of Security (HoS), which learns small per-head attention gates to separate trusted instructions from untrusted content while allowing the model to reason over that content. On Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B, the authors report lower attack success against HoS than against an undefended base model or SecAlign++ in adaptive RL-Hammer tests, with similar utility on selected benchmarks. These are author-reported results in two open-weight model settings, not an independent replication or deployment-safety result.
